_help: Hand-edit freely. Each question needs a unique id (never reuse one), a prompt and 3-5 options. The page adds 'Other (write my own)' to every question automatically. 'group' is optional (used for High Lords).

questions.prompt: Grace has many names in the Letters (the Gift, the Breath, the Light). What do people call it in the old myths?
options: The Breath (Asha) in the myths, Grace in later ages

questions.prompt: The Breath moves like wind with a heading. Where is that heading going?
options: Toward a living join — Spirit and Physical meeting, not erasing each other
Toward the Creator himself, with both worlds following
Nobody in the story ever knows; only that there is one
Toward humans as the place where both worlds are joined

questions.prompt: Virtues and sins: seven pairs, or eight with Grace vs Corruption?
options: Seven pairs; Grace stands outside the list (Letter II)
Eight pairs; Grace vs Corruption is the eighth (the bible)
Seven for people, and Grace/Corruption as the whole-person level above them

questions.prompt: Measure (Enough) sits in the middle smear. Which way does it lean?
options: Stays in the middle — law and ration both
Drifts to the Spirit side (law, limit, ban)
Drifts to the Physical side (weight, season, crop)
Splits in two: Meshal (spirit law) and Meseth (felt in the hands), as now

questions.prompt: How does the Spirit World touch the Physical World day to day?
options: Everywhere, but faintly — most people feel it, few see it
Through people: human choices open or close it
Through weather and omens that careful people can read

questions.prompt: Humanoid peoples between humans and spirits — what do we call them?
options: Use the Ashara people-names (Orineth, Selith, Kemur…) for everything
Common names like elves and dwarves, with Ashara names as their true names
New names, to be decided later
Each kingdom has its own names for them

questions.prompt: Can ordinary people see Glimmers (the good little encouragers)?
options: Never — they only feel a nudge
Rarely, at moments of real choice
Children and the humble can see them
Only Flame Order members trained to see

questions.prompt: Pride feeds the other sins ("I deserve this" → Greed, etc.). How visible is that in the story?
options: Central rule — every villain's sin traces back to Pride
Shown in the heroes, never explained out loud
Only in the deep myth (Letters), not on comic pages
Half the time — some sins stand on their own

questions.prompt: Repeated choices change a person's spirit (temptation → choice → habit → spiritual change). Can that be seen?
options: Yes — spirits literally show it to those who can see
Only through behaviour and art style (colour, shadows)
Only Flame Order tools or spirit-tech can detect it
Not visible at all; it's only moral

questions.prompt: What do people in the story call the Creator?
options: Almost never named on the page

sections.title: Ashara Offices & the First Fall
sections.blurb: The peoples of the spectrum and how the stain spread

questions.prompt: Is Ashavar the people who fall first (the 'match-head')?
options: Change to Orinel (naming as a claim)

questions.prompt: The first one of Ashavar who leaned into Pride — do they get a name?
options: Yes, a name that is spoken in the story
Yes, but only secretly known (never on the page)
No — the silence is the point
They are the 'Ancient Enemy' from the bible

questions.prompt: Two-thirds of Ashavar tipped together like a flock. Is that number known in-world?
options: Known to the Flame Order as a secret teaching
Common legend, but people get it wrong (they think it was one king)

questions.prompt: What does the faithful remnant third of Ashavar do now?
options: Quietly help humans — they know 'we cannot be the Breath'
Watch from afar and almost never act
Live hidden near the Everlight Forest

questions.prompt: 'Ashar-Kan' is a later mistaken title, as if one king sat in the Gust. How is it used in the story?
options: People believe in one dark king named Ashar-Kan; the truth is revealed late
The Empire uses the name as propaganda
The fallen Ashavar-Kan use it to seem stronger

questions.prompt: Can humans, being Body and Spirit, stand in an Ashara office (e.g. Recon in Orineth/Selith)?
options: Yes, without knowing the High Title
Yes, and some learn the title and grow in it
No — humans are outside the offices, choosing freely
Only by gift of the Breath, rarely

questions.prompt: How often do Ashara peoples appear on comic pages?
options: Often — they are part of everyday life
Through the far-physical peoples (herds, rivers, stone) all the time, spirits rarely

questions.prompt: Far-spirit peoples (Long Knowing) were redrawn as light, not dirt. Keep that look?
options: Light, but with faces you can read
Change them to look almost human
Each people gets its own colour of light

questions.prompt: The stain spread spirit first, smear next, stone last. Is the far-physical world still feeling it now?
options: Yes — weather against season, startled herds are Book 1 omens
It is getting worse right now, which is why the story starts
Only in corrupted lands (Blighted Wastes, Twinskull, Deadveil)

questions.prompt: Keep the Ashara names (Orinel, Selvar, Kemath, Nurest…) as they are?
options: Keep most, rename a few later
Keep for the deep myth; simpler common names in the comic

sections.title: The Empire
sections.blurb: Governance, the census of the corrupted, Vorash, everyday life

questions.prompt: Who rules the Empire of Man?
options: An Emperor with a Council of High Lords
A Council of High Lords only, no Emperor
The Capital Kingdom's High Lord leads the Council
An Emperor whose power is mostly ceremonial

questions.prompt: The Empire's 'census of the corrupted' (a counterfeit of Meshal). Where is it in the story?
options: Proposed during Book 1 and argued over
Comes later, as the Empire slides into Pride
Secret — run by a hidden group

questions.prompt: Everyday technology in Vorash — street lamps are…
options: Both: oil for the poor, spirit-tech for the rich
Spirit-tech in the capital, oil everywhere else

questions.prompt: How far has the Empire slid toward 'anyone who opposes us must be corrupted'?
options: Barely — the heroes see the first signs
Halfway — some officials already think this way
Far — the heroes are fighting inside a proud empire

questions.prompt: How free are member kingdoms?
options: They keep their kings, laws, dress and languages
They keep culture, but Imperial law is above theirs
Very free in peace, Imperial control in war
Some are free, some are occupied

questions.prompt: How does the Empire treat spirit-heavy and physical-heavy humanoid peoples?
options: Allies by treaty, with some distrust
Mostly ignored unless there is trouble

questions.prompt: Relationship between the Empire and the Order of the Living Flame?
options: Close allies, but the Flame keeps its independence
Old rivals who need each other
The Flame quietly opposes the census

questions.prompt: Who decides what spirit-tech is forbidden?
options: Nobody clearly — which is the problem

questions.prompt: Imperial army titles (High Lord/Grand Marshal, Marshal, General, Colonel, Commander, Captain, Lieutenant, Knight) — keep?
options: Keep, with local names in each culture

questions.prompt: The Eastern Imperial General who distrusts the Black Guard — what is he like?
options: Honest but stubborn — doctrine, not malice
A proud man the Enemy can use
Comic relief at first, tragic later

questions.prompt: Keep the draft rank ladder (Guardsman → File → Lance → Company → Wing → Arm → Banner → High Lord)?
options: Keep it, but rename some units
Go back to the bible ladder (Lance → Band → Banner → Host → Army)

questions.prompt: How big is Alaric's Banner?
options: About 50–70, small but full of leaders (bible)
Starts small and grows over the series

questions.prompt: Why is it called the Black Guard?
options: A childhood name for the Special Service that stuck
An old unit that died holding a line
Its first High Lord's house colour

questions.prompt: Black Guard look: black uniform + Imperial blue + home-culture colours and weapons. Keep?
options: Keep, with more gold for officers
Black and blue only on duty; home colours off duty
Keep, plus a sign for each Arm

questions.prompt: What spirit-tech does a normal guardsman carry?
options: Comm-stones to talk to the Banner

questions.prompt: How are guardsmen chosen?
options: Selection and training from every kingdom (where Book 1 opens)
Nominated by their kingdom's High Lord

questions.prompt: Who does the Black Guard answer to?
options: The Black Guard High Lord only
The Emperor or Council, through its High Lord
Whichever theatre commander they are attached to
It's unclear — and that causes trouble

questions.prompt: How does the Black Guard work with the Flame Order?
options: Each Banner has a Flame member attached
They call the Flame when needed
They share missions but don't trust each other
Some guardsmen are also Flame members

questions.prompt: The Recon Mute and Speaker leads: are they Wing Leads in the draft ladder?
options: Yes — two Wing Leads under Recon

questions.prompt: What do ordinary people think of the Black Guard?
options: Feared — they come when something spiritual is wrong
Not trusted — too many cultures, too much power
